hook.en: Two of the three most populous nations of the world are next door to each other. How do India, China and Pakistan compare in density, growth and sex ratio?
hook.kn: ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳು ಅಕ್ಕಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಲಿಂಗಾನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ, ಚೀನಾ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋಲುತ್ತವೆ?

objectives.en: Compare population, density and growth of the three countries
Explain the effects of China's one-child norm
Compare sex ratio, fertility and urbanisation

narration.en: Two of the three most populous nations of the world are next door to each other. How do India, China and Pakistan compare in density, growth and sex ratio?
narration.kn: ವಿಶ್ವದ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯ ಎರಡು ದೇಶಗಳು ಅಕ್ಕಪಕ್ಕದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ, ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಮತ್ತು ಲಿಂಗಾನುಪಾತದಲ್ಲಿ ಭಾರತ, ಚೀನಾ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನ ಹೇಗೆ ಹೋಲುತ್ತವೆ?

body.en: The population of Pakistan is very small, roughly one-tenth of that of China or India. China occupies the largest area of the three, so its population density is the lowest. Population growth is highest in Pakistan, followed by India and China. Scholars point to the one-child norm, introduced in China in the late 1970s, as the major reason for its low population growth. This measure also led to a decline in the sex ratio, and in a few decades China will have more elderly people in proportion to young people.

points.en: Pakistan: about one-tenth of China or India
Growth: Pakistan > India > China; one-child norm (late 1970s)

narration.en: Pakistan's population is about one-tenth of India's or China's. China has the lowest density because of its huge area, and the slowest growth because of its one-child norm, which also lowered its sex ratio and will make its population older.
narration.kn: ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಭಾರತ ಅಥವಾ ಚೀನಾದ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತನೇ ಒಂದು. ದೊಡ್ಡ ವಿಸ್ತೀರ್ಣದಿಂದ ಚೀನಾದ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಒಂದು ಮಗು ನೀತಿಯಿಂದ ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

narration.en: Let us compare the demographic indicators of the three countries in a table.

say.en: Let us make a table comparing the three countries' people.
Density: China has the largest area, so its density is the lowest of the three.
Population growth and fertility are highest in Pakistan and lowest in China, thanks to its one-child norm.
China is the most urbanised of the three.
Sex ratio is low and biased against females in all three, because of preference for sons.
Density is simply population divided by area.

body.en: The sex ratio is low and biased against females in all three countries; scholars cite son preference as the reason. All three countries are taking steps to improve the situation. The fertility rate is low in China and very high in Pakistan. Urbanisation is highest in China, while India and Pakistan have a larger share of people living in rural areas.

points.en: Low sex ratio in all three: son preference
Fertility: low in China, very high in Pakistan

narration.en: All three have a low sex ratio because families prefer sons. Fertility is lowest in China and highest in Pakistan, and China is the most urbanised.
narration.kn: ಮೂರೂ ದೇಶಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಗಂಡು ಮಗುವಿನ ಆದ್ಯತೆಯಿಂದ ಲಿಂಗಾನುಪಾತ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಫಲವತ್ತತೆ ಚೀನಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ, ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು; ನಗರೀಕರಣ ಚೀನಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

caption.en: Population P(t) = P0 × (1 + r/100)^t. Set the starting population (in millions) and the annual growth rate.

narration.en: Move the growth-rate slider. A gap of one or two per cent a year makes a big difference over fifty years.

tryThis.en: P0 = 200, r = 2: is the population about 244 million after 10 years?
Halve the growth rate. What happens to the doubling time?
Why did China's one-child norm matter so much for its future population?

problem.en: A country has 200 million people living on 8 lakh sq km. Find its population density. If its population grows at 2 per cent a year, what will it be after 10 years?

answer.en: Density 250 per sq km; population about 243.8 million after 10 years.

narration.en: Let us work through this together. A country has 200 million people living on 8 lakh sq km. Find its population density. If its population grows at 2 per cent a year, what will it be after 10 years?

body.en: One-child norm → slow population growth → fewer girls (falling sex ratio) → more elderly people later.

mnemonic.en: One child: fewer births, fewer girls, more grey hair

narration.en: One child means fewer births, fewer girls and, later, more grey hair.

points.en: Pakistan's population is about one-tenth of China's or India's; China has the lowest density.
points.kn: ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಚೀನಾ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾರತದ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತನೇ ಒಂದು; ಚೀನಾದ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ.

points.en: Growth is highest in Pakistan and lowest in China, due to the one-child norm of the late 1970s.
points.kn: ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಚೀನಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಕಾರಣ 1970ರ ದಶಕದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಒಂದು ಮಗು ನೀತಿ.

points.en: Sex ratio is low in all three; China is the most urbanised.
points.kn: ಮೂರರಲ್ಲೂ ಲಿಂಗಾನುಪಾತ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಚೀನಾ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನಗರೀಕೃತ.

homework.en: What were the effects of China's one-child norm?

narration.en: Recap. Pakistan's population is about one-tenth of China's or India's; China has the lowest density. Growth is highest in Pakistan and lowest in China, due to the one-child norm of the late 1970s. Sex ratio is low in all three; China is the most urbanised.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದ ಜನಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಚೀನಾ ಅಥವಾ ಭಾರತದ ಸುಮಾರು ಹತ್ತನೇ ಒಂದು; ಚೀನಾದ ಸಾಂದ್ರತೆ ಅತಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ. ಬೆಳವಣಿಗೆ ಪಾಕಿಸ್ತಾನದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು, ಚೀನಾದಲ್ಲಿ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಕಾರಣ 1970ರ ದಶಕದ ಕೊನೆಯ ಒಂದು ಮಗು ನೀತಿ. ಮೂರರಲ್ಲೂ ಲಿಂಗಾನುಪಾತ ಕಡಿಮೆ; ಚೀನಾ ಅತಿ ಹೆಚ್ಚು ನಗರೀಕೃತ.
